versions.changelog:
Initial release with the following features:

- Patent search via Chukonu remote MCP server, supporting both China (CNIPA) and Europe (EPO) databases
- Boolean, fielded, and full-text search on title, abstract, claims, IPC classes, applicant/inventor, type, date, and citation ranges
- Retrieve full bibliographic data and specific sections (claims, description) for individual patents
- OAuth login required; usage is read-only and quota controlled
- Tools included: patent_search, fetch, and usage, with enforced pagination
